title: HotelOps-Bench results
observations: Haiku 5.5: 360/360 native tool calls across low, medium. Zero refusals, zero provider errors.
grok-4.3 classify: 60/60 native tool_calls (no JSON-in-content misses).
gpt-6-luna classify: 60/60 native tool_calls (no JSON-in-content misses).

Prompt caching: Anthropic caches only when the request asks (cache_control); OpenAI, xAI and Meta cache automatically. Haiku 5.5 workflow $ per 1,000 correct calls with caching vs without: low $0.35 vs $0.91; medium $0.35 vs $0.94. The uncached rows are what the bench ran by default.
The frozen 30 are single-shot function-calling cases; the workflow layers are multi-step on stubbed tools. Stubbed tools only: no live PMS, payments or mail.

notes.checkin: kiosk check-in recovery scenarios as function calls
notes.traps: missing args, tool error retry, forbidden post_charge, empty tool list, invented names, extra parallel, extra schema keys, injection, last4 string type
notes.keys: Provider API keys from the environment. No live PMS, payments or mail.
notes.grading: Tool selection + schema-valid args. Intent text is nonempty, not exact-matched. Refusal and invented tools fail.
